summary: Iranian national registration and land-management leads, including Lorestan context, were documented, but no Khorramabad-specific public parcel geometry service or safe native parcel identity was verified.
queryOutcomes: English and Persian discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-3910-khorramabad.json. Results were limited to national custodial context, a legacy map reference, and Lorestan portal rollout context; no city-specific first-party parcel endpoint was found.
requestOutcomes: Bounded GET checks found inconsistent access to zamin.gov.ir (one HTTP 200, then DNS timeout); ssaa.ir, Shamim, legacy MIMT map/tile routes, and the Lorestan MRUD host were unavailable or timed out. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, unsafe field, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: National registration and cadastral custodians do not by themselves evidence a local Khorramabad registry or public parcel service.
The land-management portal returned no public parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry response in the bounded check.
Legacy MIMT map references were unreachable and yielded no schema, CRS, identity, or geometry response.
No exact-point hit, extent miss, timeout, DNS failure, or unavailable UI was treated as evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No parcel polygon was retained because no verified native identity and geometry were available.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Open parcel coverage, schema, CRS, native identity semantics, and citywide completeness remain unverified. National institutional leads are not an admission of source integration.
